moments.title: UK Festival Season: Last Day for Some
moments.blurb: Several popular festivals including Camp Bestival Shropshire, Radar Festival, Cambridge Folk Festival, and Wickham Festival wrap up their 2026 editions today.

angles.name: Festival Wrap-Up
angles.copy: That's a wrap for some of the UK's best festivals today! Who made it to Camp Bestival, Radar, Cambridge Folk or Wickham this weekend? Spill the highlights!
